{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_ids: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows: {len(duplicates)}")
print(f"Maximum sample_seq per patient: {df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().max()}")

# Verify that the dataset has multiple rows per patient
print(f"Has duplicate patient_id: {len(duplicates) > 0}")"}
